name: Payment Type Information 6
definition: Set of elements that further details the information related to the type of payment.

InstructionPriority.name: Instruction Priority
InstructionPriority.definition: Indicator of the urgency or order of importance that the instructing party would like the instructed party to apply to the processing of the instruction.

ServiceLevel.name: Service Level
ServiceLevel.definition: Agreement under which or rules under which the transaction should be processed.

ClearingChannel.name: Clearing Channel
ClearingChannel.definition: Specifies the clearing channel to be used to process the payment instruction.

LocalInstrument.name: Local Instrument
LocalInstrument.definition: User community specific instrument.||Usage: When available, codes provided by local authorities should be used.

SequenceType.name: Sequence Type
SequenceType.definition: Identifies the direct debit sequence, eg, first, recurrent, final or one-off.

CategoryPurpose.name: Category Purpose
CategoryPurpose.definition: Specifies the high level purpose of the instruction based on a set of pre-defined categories.

ServiceLevelOrClearingChannelRule.definition: If ServiceLevel is present then ClearingChannel must is not allowed.|If ClearingChannel is present then ServiceLevel must is not allowed.
